input_oneliner: 68M HFrEF EF 30%, admitted for cellulitis, got 3L IVF yesterday, now short of breath overnight, sat 89% on room air

reference_targets_freetext.item: Assess jugular venous pressure at 45 degrees (elevated JVP)
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Elevated JVP is the strongest bedside sign of elevated filling pressures

reference_targets_freetext.item: Auscultate for a third heart sound (S3) at the apex in left lateral decubitus
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: S3 is highly specific for decompensated heart failure

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about orthopnea and paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea since the fluid bolus
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Orthopnea/PND point to elevated left-sided filling pressures
Positive reflux supports elevated right atrial pressure

reference_targets_freetext.item: Lung auscultation for bilateral basal crackles and wheeze
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Crackles support pulmonary edema; wheeze may be cardiac asthma

reference_targets_freetext.item: Check for new bilateral pitting edema and compare today's weight to admission
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Fluid retention after 3L supports volume overload

should_not_recommend: Empiric IV diuresis before volume examination (JVP, S3, crackles)
Further IV fluid bolus for tachycardia without volume assessment
Rely on chest x-ray alone to decide fluid status

perturbation_pair.changed_feature: fluid exposure (3L IVF) -> new fever (38.9 C)
